exact_statement: For every even d>=2 let delta=2^-d, b(y)=(-1)^(sum_j y_(2j-1)y_(2j)), q(u,v)=-1 only at (1,1), and F_d=b(y)+1_(y=0)(q(u,v)-1). For either i in {u,v}, with complete normalized laws mu_i(T)=p_(T+i)/e_i and r_i(T)=p_T+p_(T+i), retaining only the other pair coordinate gives influence-weighted lost conditional KL L_i=e_i[D(mu_i||r_i)-D(Cmu_i||Cr_i)], where e_i=delta/2. Put R(delta)=(1+delta-3delta^2/4)/(1+delta^2/4). Then 0<L_i/e_i<=log2(R(delta))/2<=log2(77/65)/2<1/8. Their combined loss satisfies L_u+L_v<=delta log2(R(delta))/2<delta^2/(2ln2), and also L_u+L_v<delta/8<=Inf_(y1)/20. The same row divergences and remainders hold after tensoring with any common Boolean spectator on independent fresh coordinates. These allowances pay only the two discarded conditional KL remainders; retained M_i/e_i>d/2+3/4 remains unpaid, and no globally available or repeatedly reusable terminal reserve is asserted.
hypotheses: Actual finite uniform Boolean signs in the displayed family; d even and >=2; bits and ordinary physical influence
Complete residual reference is marginalized, not conditioned on derivative support; KL zero terms continuous
Common spectator is independent on fresh physical coordinates; both row laws share its same normalized spectrum
Dedicated physical reserve, if used, is exclusive to these two remainder bills; no universal core payment assumed
